title: Mime - Location, Weakness & Rewards
description: Mime in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Lumiere, Spring Meadows, Flying Waters, and six later areas

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Mimes are a recurring optional encounter scattered across at least nine areas of the game, from the prologue through the postgame. They have no elemental weakness or resistance at all, which makes them pure execution fights and the reason they are excluded from every weakness chart.

sections.title: Where to Find the Mime
sections.content:
Location: Lumiere, Spring Meadows, Flying Waters, and six later areas.

Availability: Act 1-3.

There is no elemental weakness to exploit here. Build for raw output and survivability instead of matching an element.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
• Colour of Lumina
  • Chroma Catalyst
  • Pictos or weapon tied to the encounter

Exact drop quantities for this encounter are not documented in the sources we could verify, so they are not listed rather than estimated.

sections.title: How to Beat the Mime
sections.content:
What actually kills you

Chromatic variants hit harder and hold more health than the enemy they are based on. The failure mode is almost always running out of resources mid-fight rather than a mechanic you did not understand, so bring healing headroom rather than a greedier damage build.

No elemental shortcut

With no weakness to exploit, the fight is decided by your upgrade levels and your parry timing. Check that your weapons are current before attempting it.
